name: pilotfish-mcp
description: Runs a real Chrome on your own machine and gives an MCP client 17 browser tools: compact page snapshots with element refs, click/type/select/scroll, read-only page queries, and a NEEDS A PERSON handoff (browser_resume) so a human can do sign-ins, one-time codes and CAPTCHAs in the open window. Free, MIT, no account or API key.

npm.description: Run with npx; no account or API key needed

tools.name: browser_navigate
tools.description: Open an http(s) URL in the current tab. Returns evidence and a snapshot of the visible screen.

tools.name: browser_snapshot
tools.description: The current page as a compact tree of headings, text and elements with refs to act on.

tools.name: browser_click
tools.description: Click an element by ref; refuses with a reason instead of clicking the wrong thing.

tools.name: browser_type
tools.description: Type into an input, textarea or editable element by ref, replacing its text.

tools.name: browser_select
tools.description: Choose option(s) of a <select> by label or value.

tools.name: browser_press
tools.description: Press a key or shortcut on the focused element.

tools.name: browser_scroll
tools.description: Scroll about one screen; returns evidence and newly visible elements.

tools.name: browser_get_text
tools.description: Readable text of the page (PDFs too), main content first, secrets masked.

tools.name: browser_query
tools.description: Read just the values you need with a read-only JavaScript expression returning JSON.

tools.name: browser_find
tools.description: Refs of elements anywhere on the page by the words they show or are labelled with.

tools.name: browser_actions
tools.description: Several steps in order in one call; stops at the first that fails.

tools.name: browser_resume
tools.description: Continue after a NEEDS A PERSON handoff: the person signs in or solves the check in the open window.

tools.name: browser_wait
tools.description: Wait 0.5-10 seconds for a page still loading, then return what changed.

tools.name: browser_tabs
tools.description: List the open tabs; switch_to makes another tab current.

tools.name: browser_search
tools.description: Search the web without the browser: a numbered list of title, address and snippet.

tools.name: browser_close
tools.description: Closes the browser; the next call starts a fresh one.
